hook.en: Gentle, rhythmic rocking of a joint, graded I to IV by how far into the range you go, chosen by how irritable the patient's pain is.
hook.ur: Maitland Joint Mobilization mein therapist joint ko patient ki taraf se relax halat mein chhoti, narm aur rhythm ke sath aagay-peechay harkat deta hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Maitland Joint Mobilization is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Maitland Joint Mobilization kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Maitland mobilization is a hands-on method where you move a joint passively (the patient stays relaxed) in small, smooth, repeated oscillations. The 'grade' tells you how big the movement is and how deep into the joint's range you work. You use it to calm pain or to stretch a stiff joint, then immediately check whether the patient's own movement improved.
text.ur: Maitland mobilization mein therapist joint ko patient ke relaxed rehne ke dauran passive taur par chhoti, smooth aur baar-baar dohrayi jane wali oscillations se move karta hai. Grade batata hai ke movement kitni bari hai aur joint ki range mein kitni door tak jati hai. Is ka maqsad dard ko kam karna ya stiff joint ko stretch karna ho sakta hai; is ke baad patient ki apni movement dobara check ki jati hai.

simpler.en: Gentle, rhythmic rocking of a joint, graded I to IV by how far into the range you go, chosen by how irritable the patient's pain is.
simpler.ur: Maitland Joint Mobilization mein therapist joint ko patient ki taraf se relax halat mein chhoti, narm aur rhythm ke sath aagay-peechay harkat deta hai.

text.en: Think of pushing a child on a swing. Tiny, gentle pushes near the middle calm the swing; bigger pushes toward the end of the arc stretch it out. You choose the push size by how touchy the swing is today, not by what the swing is called.
text.ur: Isay jhoolay ko dhakka dene jaisa samjhein. Darmiyani range mein chhotay aur narm dhakkay jhoolay ko calm karte hain; arc ke aakhir ke qareeb baray dhakkay usay zyada stretch karte hain. Dhakkay ka size aaj ki sensitivity ke mutabiq chuna jata hai, sirf technique ke naam se nahi.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Treat the patient's movement problem, not a scan or a diagnosis name. Pick one movement or symptom (the 'comparable sign'), treat, then test it again.
**2.** Pain-dominant and easily flared joints get small, gentle Grades I-II. Stiff but comfortable joints get Grades III-IV that reach into the resistance.
**3.** Reassessment decides everything. If the comparable sign does not improve, change the glide, the grade or the whole plan. Never just push harder.
text.ur: Patient ki movement problem ko target karein, scan ya diagnosis ke naam ko nahi. Ek movement ya symptom ko comparable sign ke taur par select karein, treatment se pehle note karein aur baad mein dobara test karein. Dard se jaldi bharrak uthne walay joint mein Grades I–II ki chhoti aur narm movements use ki ja sakti hain; zyada stiff magar relatively calm joint mein Grades III–IV resistance ki taraf jati hain. Agar comparable sign behtar na ho to glide, grade ya poora plan dobara dekhein—sirf zyada zor na lagayein.

text.en:
So when does **Maitland Joint Mobilization** make sense?
• A painful, stiff joint where one movement clearly reproduces the patient's pain (positive comparable sign).
• Pain-dominant, irritable joints (use Grades I-II) or stiffness-dominant, calmer joints (use Grades III-IV).
• Stiffness after immobilisation or injury once the tissue is safe to load.
text.ur: Yeh approach us waqt consider ki ja sakti hai jab joint painful ya stiff ho aur koi movement patient ki pehchani hui takleef ko reproduce kare. Stiffness after immobilisation ya injury mein bhi sirf tab consider karein jab tissue ko load dena safe ho. Unstable fracture, dislocation, active infection ya us area mein cancer ka shak ho to routine mobilization na karein. Barhtay neurological signs ya neck mein blood-vessel safety ke bare mein uncertainty ho to ruk kar munasib assessment karein. Hypermobility, recent trauma aur bohat irritable pain mein extra ehtiyat zaroori hai.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Unstable fracture, dislocation, active infection, or suspected cancer in the area.
• Worsening neurological signs, or uncertainty about blood vessel safety (especially in the neck).
• Take extra care in hypermobile joints, recent trauma and highly irritable pain.
text.ur:
Utna hi zaroori — kab yeh technique NAHI karni, ya kab ruk jana hai:
• Unstable fracture, dislocation, active infection, or suspected cancer in the area.
• Worsening neurological signs, or uncertainty about blood vessel safety (especially in the neck).
• Take extra care in hypermobile joints, recent trauma and highly irritable pain.

title.en: How to do it — 8 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 8 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Choose and record the comparable sign
steps.detail: Example: right neck rotation reaches 50 degrees and pain starts at 45. Write it down so you can prove change later.

steps.title: Screen for red flags
steps.detail: Ask about night pain, unexplained weight loss, recent trauma, dizziness or neurological symptoms before touching.

steps.title: Position for comfort
steps.detail: Support the joint so surrounding muscles can relax. A guarding muscle will block any glide you try.

steps.title: Place a broad, specific contact
steps.detail: One hand fixes the bone that should stay still. The other contacts the moving bone close to the joint line. Take up the skin slack first so you move the joint, not the skin.

steps.title: Use your body weight, not your fingers
steps.detail: Lean smoothly through relaxed arms. Finger-only pressure makes jerky, painful oscillations.

steps.title: Start low and ask
steps.detail: Begin with a low grade. Local pressure is fine. Sharp pain, pins and needles or symptoms spreading down the limb mean stop.

steps.title: Treat, rest, then retest
steps.detail: After a set, ask the patient to repeat the comparable sign. Keep, progress or change the technique based on that answer.

steps.title: Hand the gain back to the patient
steps.detail: Finish with active movement or loading in the new range, so the improvement is used rather than lost.

beats.ur: 1. Comparable sign choose aur record karein; misal ke taur par right neck rotation 50 degrees tak pohanchti hai aur 45 degrees par dard shuru hota hai. 2. Red flags screen karein, jaise raat ka dard, baghair wazeh wajah weight kam hona, recent trauma, chakkar ya neurological symptoms. 3. Joint ko comfortable position mein support karein taake aas-paas ke muscles relax kar saken. 4. Ek hand se us bone ko stabilize karein jo still rehni chahiye aur doosray se joint line ke qareeb moving bone par specific contact banayein; pehle skin ka slack lein. 5. Sirf fingers se zor dene ke bajaye relaxed arms aur body weight se smooth movement dein. 6. Low grade se shuru karein aur patient se symptoms poochhein. Tez dard, pins-and-needles ya limb mein phailti symptoms hon to rok dein. 7. Set ke baad comparable sign dobara test karein aur response ke mutabiq technique rakhein, badlein ya progress karein. 8. Aakhir mein active movement ya loading karwayein taake patient nayi range ko khud use kare.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: about 1-2 oscillations per second, 30-60 seconds per set, 2-4 sets. Grades I-II for pain, III-IV for stiffness. This is a starting point; the patient's response sets the real dose.
text.ur: Aam teaching range takreeban 1–2 oscillations per second, har set 30–60 seconds aur 2–4 sets hai. Dard ke liye Grades I–II aur stiffness ke liye Grades III–IV ka zikr hota hai. Yeh sirf starting range hai; asal dose patient ke response ke mutabiq hoti hai.

beats.patient: Ravi, 45, bank clerk, right-sided neck pain since a long drive four days ago.
beats.assessment: Right rotation is 50 degrees with pain at the end. Pain eases within a minute of resting, so irritability is low. Screening is clear. A gentle press on the right C5 joint reproduces his pain.
beats.treatment: In lying, Ravi relaxes while you apply a Grade III unilateral PA glide at C5 for 30 seconds, three sets, asking about symptoms after each set.
beats.reassess: Rotation improves to 65 degrees with less pain. You teach him gentle active rotation every hour and review in two days. If rotation had not changed, you would try another level or direction instead of pressing harder.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Ravi, 45 saal ka bank clerk, chaar din pehle lambi drive ke baad neck ke right side dard report karta hai. Right rotation 50 degrees hai aur end par dard hota hai; aaram karne se dard ek minute mein kam ho jata hai, screening clear hai aur right C5 joint par gentle pressure usi dard ko reproduce karta hai. Lita kar Ravi ko relax rehne diya jata hai aur C5 par Grade III unilateral PA glide 30 seconds ke liye, teen sets mein apply ki jati hai; har set ke baad symptoms poochay jate hain. Dobara test par rotation 65 degrees tak behtar hoti hai aur dard kam hota hai. Phir gentle active rotation har ghantay sikhayi jati hai aur do din baad review hota hai. Agar rotation na badalti to zyada zor lagane ke bajaye doosra level ya direction consider ki jati.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Picking a grade from the diagnosis name instead of irritability and response.
• Moving the whole limb instead of producing a true, specific joint glide.
• Feeling a joint 'loosen' under your hand but skipping the retest of the patient's own movement.
text.ur: Diagnosis ke naam se grade chun lena, irritability aur response ko nazar-andaz karna; poori limb ko hila dena magar specific joint glide na dena; ya hand ke neeche joint smooth mehsoos hone par patient ki apni movement dobara test na karna.

text.en: Reviews support manual therapy, including mobilization, for short-term pain and function in several joint problems, usually alongside exercise. How it works is uncertain. It does not 'put a joint back in place', and one technique should not be promised to fix a specific structure.
text.ur: Movement test karein, glide aur grade chunein, phir movement dobara test karein. Reviews ke mutabiq manual therapy, mobilization samet, kai joint problems mein short-term pain aur function mein madad de sakti hai, aam tor par exercise ke sath. Is ka mechanism yaqini taur par maloom nahi. Yeh joint ko 'wapas jagah par bithana' nahi hai aur kisi ek technique se kisi specific structure ko theek karne ka wada nahi karna chahiye.
